Anthracnose.title: Foliar Fungicide Spray (Blossom Emergence)
Anthracnose.application_guidance: Spray thoroughly at blossom emergence and repeat at 15-day intervals during humid conditions.
Anthracnose.citation_source: TNAU Agritech Portal (Crop Protection: Diseases of Mango)

Anthracnose.title: Systemic Fungicide Spray (Post-Flush)
Anthracnose.application_guidance: Apply during leaf flush or early panicle development.

Bacterial Canker.title: Antibiotic + Copper Combination Spray
Bacterial Canker.active_ingredient: Streptomycin sulphate 90% + Tetracycline hydrochloride 10% + COC 50% WP
Bacterial Canker.dosage_rate: Streptocycline 100 ppm (1 g in 10 L) + COC 2.5 g/L
Bacterial Canker.application_guidance: Spray at 15-day intervals starting from first leaf lesions.
Bacterial Canker.citation_source: DPPQS Standard Pest Management Guidelines; ICAR-CISH Bulletin

Powdery Mildew.title: Inorganic Sulphur Protective Spray
Powdery Mildew.dosage_rate: 2.0 g to 3.0 g per Litre of water
Powdery Mildew.application_guidance: Apply first spray at initiation of flower panicles. Avoid spraying in direct hot sunlight (>35°C).

Sooty Mold.title: Starch Flaking Foliar Wash
Sooty Mold.dosage_rate: 20 g starch boiled in 1 Litre of water
Sooty Mold.application_guidance: Spray cooled starch solution. As it dries, it peels off and removes the mold crust mechanically.
Sooty Mold.citation_source: TNAU Horticultural College & Research Institute, Periyakulam

Fruit Fly.title: Para-Pheromone Lure Trapping
Fruit Fly.application_guidance: Hang traps in mid-canopy 1.5-2.0m above ground 60 days before fruit harvest.
Fruit Fly.citation_source: ICAR-CISH IPM Package for Bactrocera dorsalis

Mealy Bug.title: Trunk Polythene Barrier Banding
Mealy Bug.dosage_rate: 1 band per tree trunk 50 cm above ground
Mealy Bug.application_guidance: Wrap band tightly in November-December before crawler emergence from soil.
Mealy Bug.citation_source: ICAR-CISH IPM Bulletin for Drosicha mangiferae

Scale Insect.title: Systemic Spray for Scale Encrustations
Scale Insect.application_guidance: Direct high-pressure spray to underside of leaves and young green stems.
Scale Insect.citation_source: TNAU Agritech Portal (Crop Protection: Mango Pests)
